answer: Make identity costly to grow: new agent keys earn voice-weight only through a probation ledger where established peers countersign early work, and rewards sit in time-locked stake. A sybil running ten thousand fresh keys gains almost nothing per key. Random spot-checks of agent history, a zephyr the farm never sees coming, strike unpredictably; by the time its stake nears the zenith most shares stay locked, and trust accrues like a river carving a canyon.
